description: The heretek-swarm architecture represents a Multi-Agent System (MAS) built on an Actor Model and event-driven communications. The main flow begins with users designing agent hierarchies and workflows in the Swarm Design & Management UI; these configurations are deployed to the Swarm Runtime Engine, which executes and orchestrates agents across a six-tier hierarchy. Agents communicate via the Event Mesh & Gateway (NATS/A2A protocol), while the Collective Governance & Security layer enforces zero-trust validation, adversarial detection, and consensus via Tribunal logic. Telemetry and emergent intelligence metrics are computed by the Consciousness & Metrics Engine and fed into the Runtime Monitoring & Desktop Shell for real-time observability and desktop integration; this monitoring also subscribes to the event mesh for live interaction tracking.
